name: browser_read
description: Look at web pages in a private server browser: navigate, read rendered text, measure element sizes and positions, sample rendered pixel colours, read page-load timing, wait for and time conditions, inspect animations, scroll, emulate phone/desktop and dark mode, and take screenshots that attach to the reply. Signed out on public sites; clicking and typing use browser_input

url.description: navigate only: a full http or https URL. A WebAgent app URL opens signed in as the current user and returns once the app has booted

signed_in.description: navigate only: false opens the WebAgent app signed out (default true)

selector.description: CSS selector. read/measure/animations/wait_for: every match. scroll: element to bring into view or whose scroll container to scroll. pixels: sample the centre of the first rendered match

offset.description: read: character offset; measure: element offset. Use next_offset from the previous result

condition.description: wait_for only: visible/hidden need selector; text needs text; quiet waits until the page stops changing for quiet_ms; animations_done ignores endless animations; network_idle waits until no request finished for quiet_ms

text.description: wait_for condition text only: the text to wait for

timeout_ms.description: wait_for only: give up after this long (default 5000)

quiet_ms.description: wait_for quiet/network_idle: how long it must stay still (default 500)

preset.description: viewport only: phone 390x844, phone_small 360x640 and tablet 768x1024 emulate touch devices; desktop 1280x900, desktop_wide 1440x900; navigate again afterwards

styles.description: measure only: include computed CSS for each element (5 elements per call)

points.description: pixels only: viewport points in CSS px
